mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_PENDING_DATA WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND PRIORITY IN ('HIGH', 'URGENT') AND SETTLEMENT_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY CASE PRIORITY WHEN 'URGENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, EXPECTED_SETTLEMENT_DATE ASC, CREATE_TIME ASC

SELECT * FROM TBL_PENDING_DATA WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId} AND SETTLEMENT_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'PROCESSING') AND EXPECTED_SETTLEMENT_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) ORDER BY EXPECTED_SETTLEMENT_DATE ASC

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN 1 END) AS processingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'SETTLED' THEN 1 END) AS settledCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN 1 END) AS failedCount, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'PROCESSING' THEN SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS processingAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'SETTLED' THEN SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS settledAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SETTLEMENT_STATUS = 'FAILED' THEN SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedAmount, COALESCE(SUM(SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalAmount FROM TBL_PENDING_DATA WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND ORG_ID = #{orgId}
